description: Table Changes Replicated to a Kinesis Data Stream
rationale: A Kinesis streaming destination copies every item-level change, including the full old and new images of each item, into a Kinesis data stream. Those records leave the table's encryption boundary: they are protected by whatever key and retention the destination stream is configured with, and read by whoever holds kinesis:GetRecords on it, neither of which is governed by the table's KMS key or its resource-based policy. The destination therefore has to be reviewed as a copy of the table in its own right.
remediation: Confirm the destination stream is still required, that it is encrypted with a KMS key at least as protected as the table's, and that read access to it is restricted to the consumers that need it
